messages.content: What's the deadline for sending back a product?
You can return an item within 45 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and in its original packaging.
Once my return reaches you, how soon is the money refunded?
Your refund is paid back to your original payment method within 5 business days after the returned item arrives at our warehouse.
Above what order value is delivery free of charge?
Standard shipping is free on orders over €60. Orders of €60 or less pay €4.95 for standard shipping.
What is the price of the fast delivery option?
Express shipping costs €12. Express orders placed before 14:00 arrive on the next business day.
Is it possible to get an order delivered to Canada?
We ship to every EU country, plus the United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland. We do not ship outside Europe.
Which city do I have to travel to if I want to collect my order myself?
You can pick up your order at our warehouse in Tilburg, in the Netherlands, from Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 17:00.
Until what time can I reach customer service on a weekday?
Customer support is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 10:00 to 16:00, Central European Time. It is closed on Sundays.
What is the name of your rewards scheme?
Our loyalty programme is called Oak Points. You earn 1 Oak Point per euro spent, and 100 Oak Points can be exchanged for a €5 discount.
Is it possible to apply several coupons to one order?
Only one discount code can be used per order, and discount codes cannot be used to buy gift cards.
For how long can a gift voucher be used after it's bought?
Gift cards come in values of €25, €50 and €100, and they are valid for 3 years from the date of purchase.
What is the deadline for telling you that something arrived broken?
An item that arrives damaged must be reported within 7 days, with a photo of the damage. We then send a replacement free of charge.
Can you refund the difference if a competitor sells it for less?
If the same item is sold for less by another retailer in the EU within 14 days of your purchase, we refund the difference.
How many days does it take for my account to be erased?
Your account is deleted within 30 days of your request. Order history is kept for 7 years, because tax law requires it.
How many minutes can I wait before typing in the login code from the SMS?
The two-factor login code sent by text message is valid for 10 minutes.
Which payment options can I choose from?
We accept credit and debit cards, PayPal, iDEAL and Klarna. With Klarna, you can pay within 30 days.
How long is a ceiling light covered by the warranty?
Furniture has a 2-year warranty, and lighting has a 1-year warranty.
